policy.identity: Global mirror-normalized piece-only identity for current v2 input, plus exact initial-FEN/history hash
policy.node_budget: One go nodes N per position, no movetime; last completed iteration score
policy.results: Only python-chess outcome(claim_draw=True) yields WDL; truncated games have null result
policy.sampling: Root before each move, generated ply modulo sample_every equals zero; quiet exact cp only
policy.scope: Data generation only; no model training, deployment or strength estimate
policy.split: Seed families stratified by source kind before play; related variants must share a family
policy.teacher: Own Regicide classical evaluation with own fixed-node search
policy.tt: New game token for every query; empty TT; full initial FEN and history retained
